summaries.name: Alternative Therapies in Health and Medicine
summaries.summary: Alternative Therapies in Health and Medicine published a study of 15 subjects with anxiety and depression who listened to binaural beats daily for four weeks, finding significant improvements in anxiety and depression symptoms and reduced stress levels.

summaries.name: International Journal of Psychophysiology
summaries.summary: The International Journal of Psychophysiology published a study finding that binaural beats can positively affect mood and emotional states, with subjects who listened to binaural beats reporting significantly less anxiety and more positive moods than those who didn't.

summaries.name: Music and Medicine
summaries.summary: The journal Music and Medicine published a study of 38 subjects who listened to binaural beats for 30 minutes daily for three weeks, finding significant reductions in symptoms of depression, anxiety, and stress.
